Take a shelter dog out for the day in Arizona

Want to rent or borrow a dog in Arizona? These shelters let you take an adoptable dog on a day trip, hike or sleepover for free. 6 shelter programs in Arizona, 5 of them open to the public. Cities include Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tombstone, Tucson, Yuma.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.
